title: Spellglass gesture pack, format gesturepack/1
description: A player's redrawn gestures, exported from the Workshop as one file (blueprint Section 11.1; TypeScript shape in src/contracts/packs.ts GesturePack). An imported gesture pack is a layer: the player's own drawings win, then enabled gesture packs (newest first), then the spell pack's gesture. Gestures are stored right-handed; the left-handed switch mirrors them when the spellbook is built. Unknown fields are allowed and kept.
